tasks.label: Configure
args: $cmakeExe = $env:CMAKE_COMMAND; if (-not $cmakeExe) { $found = Get-Command cmake -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($found) { $cmakeExe = $found.Source } }; if (-not $cmakeExe -and (Test-Path 'build/vs2026/CMakeCache.txt')) { $entry = Select-String -Path 'build/vs2026/CMakeCache.txt' -Pattern '^CMAKE_COMMAND:INTERNAL='; if ($entry) { $cmakeExe = $entry.Line.Split('=', 2)[1] } }; if (-not $cmakeExe) { throw 'CMake im PATH bereitstellen oder CMAKE_COMMAND setzen.' }; & $cmakeExe '-S' '.' '-B' 'build/vs2026' '-G' 'Visual Studio 18 2026' '-A' 'x64'; exit $LASTEXITCODE

tasks.label: Build
args: $cmakeExe = $env:CMAKE_COMMAND; if (-not $cmakeExe) { $found = Get-Command cmake -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($found) { $cmakeExe = $found.Source } }; if (-not $cmakeExe -and (Test-Path 'build/vs2026/CMakeCache.txt')) { $entry = Select-String -Path 'build/vs2026/CMakeCache.txt' -Pattern '^CMAKE_COMMAND:INTERNAL='; if ($entry) { $cmakeExe = $entry.Line.Split('=', 2)[1] } }; if (-not $cmakeExe) { throw 'CMake im PATH bereitstellen oder CMAKE_COMMAND setzen.' }; & $cmakeExe '--build' 'build/vs2026' '--config' 'Release'; exit $LASTEXITCODE
